purpose: Define dataset as an explicit catalogable logical projection/scope over exact DWH resources, separate from schema identity, storage binding, query result and physical artifact.

topics.name: DWH Dataset Identity
topics.purpose: Define dataset as an explicit catalogable logical projection/scope over exact DWH resources, separate from schema identity, storage binding, query result and physical artifact.

semantics.identity_rule: Every cataloged dataset has an explicit stable dataset identity.
semantics.resource_rule: Dataset references exact instance/schema/resource/field/query/projection identities as applicable.
semantics.schema_rule: Dataset schema binding is explicit and does not replace schema identity.
semantics.storage_rule: Physical storage location/backend is a binding only.
semantics.result_rule: A transient query result is not automatically a dataset identity.
semantics.ownership_rule: Dataset catalog identity does not transfer ownership from underlying resource owners.
semantics.version_rule: Dataset version/profile is explicit where its semantic scope changes.
semantics.authority_rule: Dataset visibility does not grant data access.

invariants.rule: Catalog and metadata records describe exact DWH resources and evidence; discovery, labels, annotations, ranking or catalog visibility never replace canonical resource identity, semantic ownership, classification policy or authorization.

hard_gates.condition: storage path used as dataset identity
dataset becomes owner of source schema

references.purpose: Datasets bind exact schema/resource graph identities.
Projection/materialization remains separate from dataset catalog identity.
